lines.t: I've been walking slow through the quiet in my soul
Trying to understand the pieces I don't hold
I tell myself I'm worthless, but you whisper I belong
Your voice is like a heartbeat pulling me back where I'm strong
Why do I keep wondering if I'm enough in your eyes
When every breath you give me is proof you gave your life
Tell me what I'm made for, yeah, who's you?
I've been feeling lost but you're the truth I'm running to
You lift me when I tremble and I break, you carry through
Tell me what I'm made for
I'm made for you
Some days I feel hollow, like I'm drifting far away
But even in the silence I can hear you when I pray
Your comfort wraps around me, like a light I can't explain
A promise in the darkness, that I'll never fall in vain
Why does every moment feel like you're calling me home
Even when I'm doubting, you remind me I'm not alone
Tell me what I'm made for, yeah, who's you?
I've been feeling lost but you're the truth I'm running to
You lift me when I tremble and I break you, carry through
Tell me what I'm made for
I'm made for you
Maybe I'm unfolding slowly
Maybe you are healing every fear
Maybe all the breaking only
Makes room for you to draw me near
Tell me what I'm made for, yahushua
You restore my heart each time I'm torn in two
If I find the faith to open just a little more
I'll see what I'm made for
I'm made for you
Ooh, ooh, ooh
